अपिहित --पिहित p. p.
1 Shut, closed,
covered, concealed (fig. also);
बाष्पापिहेत covered with tears.
--2 Not
concealed, plain, clear; अर्थो
गिरामपिहितः पिहितश्च किंचित्, सत्यं
चकास्ति मरहदृवधूस्तनाभः Subhāṣ.

पिहित p. p.
1 Shut, closed,
barred.
--2 Covered, concealed,
hidden.
--3 Filled or covered with;
see अपिहित also.
--तं A figure of
speech which consists in
insinuating to a person that one knows his
secrets.
